Phase 9 — chrome/panels/dialogs/menus baseline failures

==================================================================
Failing test #1
==================================================================
Test: Phase9ChromeTest.AlignmentButtonGlyphsAreNotPlainArrows
Audit rows: UI-VF-01, UI-VF-02, UI-VF-03, UI-VF-04
Locations:
  src/ui/TextEditToolBar.cpp:166 — alignLeftButton  text is U+2190 (←)
  src/ui/TextEditToolBar.cpp:175 — alignCenterButton text is U+2194 (↔)
  src/ui/TextEditToolBar.cpp:183 — alignRightButton text is U+2192 (→)
  src/ui/TextEditToolBar.cpp:191 — alignJustifyButton text is U+2195 (↕)

Failure output (excerpt):
  alignJustifyButton text is U+2195 (↕ up-down arrow), which
  semantically means 'vertical position adjustment'. Replace with
  U+2261 (≡) or an icon. (UI-VF-01)
  alignLeftButton text is a plain arrow glyph (U+2190). (UI-VF-02)
  alignCenterButton text is a plain arrow glyph (U+2194). (UI-VF-03)
  alignRightButton text is a plain arrow glyph (U+2192). (UI-VF-04)

Resolution plan:
  Swap the four arrow glyphs in TextEditToolBar.cpp for proper
  alignment glyphs:
    Left:    U+2B05 ⇤ (left-arrow with bar) or icon-set glyph
    Center:  U+2261 ≡  (three horizontal bars)  — center-aligned visually
    Right:   U+2B0E ⇥  (right-arrow with bar) or icon-set glyph
    Justify: U+2630 ☰  (trigram for heaven, hamburger menu)
              equivalent to four full-width bars — universally read
              as "justify"
  Accessible names ("Align Left/Center/Right/Justify") are not
  changed.

==================================================================
Failing test #2
==================================================================
Test: Phase9ChromeTest.NoTwoActionsBindTheSameSaveAndSignShortcut
Audit row: UI-KB-04
Location: src/ui/MainWindow.cpp:769

Failure output (excerpt):
  signDocumentAction_ binds Ctrl+Shift+S at line 769 of
  MainWindow.cpp — collides with QKeySequence::SaveAs (Ctrl+Shift+S
  on Windows). Rebind to Ctrl+Alt+S (UI-KB-04).
  Line: signDocumentAction_->setShortcut(QKeySequence(tr("Ctrl+Shift+S")));

Resolution plan:
  Rebind src/ui/MainWindow.cpp:769 from
    QKeySequence(tr("Ctrl+Shift+S"))
  to
    QKeySequence(tr("Ctrl+Alt+S"))
  saveAsAction_ keeps its QKeySequence::SaveAs binding.

==================================================================
Failing test #3
==================================================================
Test: Phase9ChromeTest.CanvasExposesContextMenuRequestSignal
Audit row: UI-CTX-01
Location: src/ui/PdfCanvas.h / .cpp — no contextMenuEvent override

Failure output (excerpt):
  PdfCanvas must expose canvasContextMenuRequested(QPoint) so
  MainWindow can show a default canvas context menu (UI-CTX-01).
  Pre-fix the canvas right-click is a no-op.

Resolution plan:
  Add to PdfCanvas:
    signals: void canvasContextMenuRequested(QPoint screenPos);
    protected:  void contextMenuEvent(QContextMenuEvent* ev) override;
  contextMenuEvent emits canvasContextMenuRequested with the
  global position of the right-click. MainWindow connects to this
  signal and shows a tool-aware menu (Zoom In / Zoom Out / Fit
  Page / Fit Width / Single Page / Continuous etc.).

==================================================================
Deferred-to-Phase-D1 (acknowledged)
==================================================================
UI-CTX-02 — Text-edit context menu currently shows only Atlas
  Mode submenu (MainWindow.cpp:3608-3640). Acrobat shows
  Cut/Copy/Paste/Select All. Implementing those touches
  TextEditTool internals (Phase-3 territory) and is structurally
  better grouped with the D1 final-integration cycle that already
  consolidates cross-subsystem text-edit work.

UI-CTX-03 — Annotation right-click context menu (Properties /
  Delete / Reply on a selected annotation). Implementing requires
  SelectTool integration (Phase-4 territory). Defer to D1.

UI-CTX-11 — TextEditTool selection right-click full menu
  (Cut/Copy/Paste/Bold/Italic/Find). Same TextEditTool internals
  scope as CTX-02; defer to D1.

UI-KB-07 — Ctrl+Q exit-prompt for dirty document. closeEvent
  flow with a QMessageBox confirm — adequately exercised by the
  pywinauto smoke layer at the harness level; the kernel
  contract (UndoManager::isClean drives the prompt) is locked
  by UndoManagerCleanStateDrivesDirtyMarker.
